problem_statement: Build a brand-new /reading page from scratch on this Gatsby portfolio site (bchiang7 v4 style, styled-components). The route /reading does not exist yet (baseline 404/empty). Construct a full 'Reading List' page that reuses the site's existing design system and the shared Layout (nav + footer + theme) exactly like sibling pages such as /archive. The page shows a curated list of books/papers grouped by shelf (Engineering / ML / Design) and lets the visitor filter the grid by shelf via a real client-side interaction that updates a live count. Must be responsive with no horizontal overflow at 390px.
required_content:
A page

Reading List

heading inside the shared
An intro subtitle paragraph: 'Books and papers shaping how I build software'
A row of shelf filter <button>s: All, Engineering, ML, Design (each carrying data-shelf=<lowercased>)

A live status

reading 'Showing {n} books' (or 'Showing {n} {Shelf} books' once a shelf is chosen)
A responsive grid of book cards; each card shows its shelf label, the book <h3> title, the author, and a one-line blurb
At least the books 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications' (Engineering) and 'Hands-On Machine Learning' (ML) among 6 curated entries
The shared site nav (About / Experience / Projects / Skills / Contact) and footer must render identically to sibling pages via the reused <Layout>
design_constraints: Reuse the site design system: CSS variables --green (#64ffda), --navy/--light-navy backgrounds, --font-mono for meta/buttons, --font-sans for body, var(--border-radius)
Reuse the shared <Layout> from @components so nav + social rail + footer + theme match /archive and / (cross-page consistency)
Filter buttons follow the site's green outline button idiom; active shelf is visually indicated (aria-pressed + green tint)
No horizontal overflow at 390px: single-column card grid on mobile
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /reading(空 Fragment stub, 无 Layout); reference 完整实现 useState shelf filter; bad 从 reference 拷贝但 shelf 硬编码 'All' + onClick no-op → 默认渲染与 reference 逐像素一致(过 dom/visual/consistency),点击 ML 后 status 不变 → 只 fail interaction_assertions。跨页一致性编码为 dom_assertions: nav 链接 About/Experience/Contact 同时绑在 desktop_reading 与 sibling desktop_archive 上。gatsby-plugin-offline 已从三份 config 移除并 clean rebuild(#18ai/#18al);footer 的 api.github.com fetch 已在三份中同样禁用(#18t)。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。

_build_meta.install: (corepack enable && corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile) || npm install
